speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Sit. The goose is out. The sermon is not coming in with you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sermon stayed at the porch. I brought an appetite and a damp cloak.

speaker: richard_field
text: Hang the cloak on the stair, not on my copy. Thou art dripping on a sheet I have not folded.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God keep thy sheets dry, Richard. Jacqueline, this is a goose and a kindness.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: It is a goose. The kindness is that I told him to stop asking you things at table.

speaker: richard_field
text: I have asked nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the new manner. Last week you wanted a third poem, and the second volume home.

speaker: richard_field
text: And thou told me there is a duke, four lovers, and a weaver, and more in the book than one king. I heard thee. Eat.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: If both of you have finished with books, one of you may cut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He cuts. I have paid for paper often enough to know whose knife it is.

speaker: richard_field
text: Two cuts, then. The breast for Jacqueline. The leg for the man who will not give me Fridays.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: You are going to court.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Up the river, if the river allows. Wednesday, if Monday holds.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: A man going to court should take a second shirt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have a shirt.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: You have the shirt you are wearing in my kitchen, and it has heard a sermon. Take a second. Two shirts, Will. Not a speech about one.

speaker: richard_field
text: She is right, and I am not saying it as a printer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two shirts. I will leave the chronicle where it is.

speaker: richard_field
text: I did not ask for the chronicle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know. That is worse.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Eat the goose before you make a proverb of a shirt. There is mustard. There is enough for three.

speaker: richard_field
text: Thou wilt be stared at, up there. Players are. Come back with the same hands.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will come back with two shirts, one of them dirty, and the book still in my room.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The book is not the dinner. The goose is. Sit nearer the fire and eat.

speaker: richard_field
text: This Sunday, then. I am glad of it, and I will not spend it on a volume.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. God keep you both.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: God keep you. And the second shirt. Do not tell me, after, what the Queen wore. Tell me whether you were fed.
